name: White power skinhead
summary: White power skinheads are the neo-Nazi, white-supremacist and antisemitic strand of the skinhead subculture. Their ideology is, in the words of the sources, essentially neo-Nazism lived through a subculture of shaved heads, boots, violence and white power music.
scope: The racist (neo-Nazi, white power) skinhead movement that split from the British skinhead subculture in the late 1970s and spread through Europe and North America from the 1980s: its neo-Nazi and antisemitic racialism, its music scene (Skrewdriver, Rock against Communism, Blood & Honour), its violence and its puritan, working-class, male self-image, as ADL (2015, 1988 report), the SPLC, Pollard (2016) and Goodrick-Clarke (chapter 10) describe it. ADL states that racist skinheads' ideology is essentially the same as neo-Nazi ideology; the profile covers what those sources say the skinheads hold, not neo-Nazism in general. Excluded: the original 1960s skinhead subculture, traditional and anti-racist (SHARP, RASH) skinheads, Oi! bands that are not racist, and other neo-Nazi groups except where the sources tie them to the skinheads.

sources.usedFor: Novel treated by the sources as inspirational reading for neo-Nazi skinheads; its stated programme (race war, whites-only territory, gun raids, Day of the Rope).

armed-group-creates-revolution.rationale: The Turner Diaries (key work) tells of a small armed 'Organization' whose terror, provoked by the Gun Raids, brings on a wider revolution; Goodrick-Clarke (ch. 10) says the NF's leaders saw skinheads as paramilitary irregulars for street battles.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: ADL 2015 lists the belief that white culture is superior to other cultures; Pollard's racialism points the same way.

democracy-best.rationale: Goodrick-Clarke ch. 10 (last pages): the neo-Nazi aim in the skinhead scene is to broadcast 'racism and contempt for liberalism and democracy'; The Turner Diaries ch. XXIV scorns 'liberal-Jewish democracy'.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: The Turner Diaries (chapters VIII and XXIII) attacks 'mixed-race couples' and has 'race traitors' hanged on the Day of the Rope; ADL 2015's 'Mantra' calls white intermarriage 'genocide'.

elite-replacement.rationale: ADL 2015 reports the white-extinction belief that a rising tide of non-whites is controlled and manipulated by Jews, and the 'Mantra' calling intermarriage a program of genocide; the ADL says racist skinheads hold the same beliefs as neo-Nazis.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: ADL 2015: white supremacists hold that whites should be dominant over others; The Turner Diaries treats non-whites as people to be removed or killed.

ethnic-nation.rationale: ADL 2015 lists the belief that whites should live by themselves in a whites-only society; The Turner Diaries ch. XXIV celebrates fields where 'every face I saw ... was White'.

hereditarian-race.rationale: Pollard (2016 abstract) names racialism the movement's central idea above all; ADL 2015 lists belief in white genetic superiority; Goodrick-Clarke ch. 10 notes the 'biological monism' and 'laws of nature' of Hawthorne's skinhead circle.

limit-guns.rationale: The Turner Diaries (ch. I) treats the Cohen Act banning private firearms and the Gun Raids as tyranny and shames those who surrendered their guns.

minority-conspiracy.rationale: ADL 2015: the core belief is that whites face extinction by non-whites 'controlled and manipulated by the Jews'; Goodrick-Clarke ch. 10 quotes Skrewdriver's 'kosher power' lyric; The Turner Diaries (ch. XXIV) speaks of 'liberal-Jewish democracy'.

political-violence-legitimate.rationale: ADL (2015, 'Racist Skinheads') says violence is widely condoned among racist skinheads, even as a recreational activity; the ADL 1988 report says they preach violence against Blacks, Hispanics, Jews, Asians and homosexuals; The Turner Diaries (chapters I and XXIII, the Gun Raids and Day of the Rope) presents violence as the road to the 'Great Revolution'.

race-based-immigration-restrictions.rationale: A whites-only society (ADL 2015; The Turner Diaries) couldn't be reached while admitting non-white immigrants; Goodrick-Clarke ch. 10 describes the scene as a reaction to non-European immigration.

race-social-construct.rationale: Pollard puts racialism first among the skinhead ideas; ADL 2015 lists white genetic superiority; Goodrick-Clarke ch. 10 cites 'biological monism' of the skinhead-linked Creativity circle.

racial-group-interests.rationale: ADL 2015 gives the Fourteen Words, 'We must secure the existence of our people and a future for white children', as the core slogan; Goodrick-Clarke (ch. 10) says Nazi skinheads believe they fight for the racial survival of the European races; ADL calls the Hammerskin Nation a 'White power Skinhead group'.

racial-pride.rationale: The ADL 1988 report treats 'white pride' as the slogan of skinheads and says it denotes at least some measure of racist feeling; the movement's own name is white power (ADL Hammerskin profile).

reduce-immigration.rationale: Goodrick-Clarke ch. 10: skinhead gangs roam in search of immigrants and asylum seekers, and white power groups see the 'flood of colored peoples' as a threat to racial survival; the ADL 1988 report names Third World immigrants as their favourite targets.

remove-other-ethnic-groups-from-country.rationale: The Turner Diaries (chapters XXI-XXIV) describes the evacuation and killing of Blacks, Jews and 'mongrels' to make a purely white territory; ADL 2015 says white supremacists want whites to live by themselves in a whites-only society.

revolution-legitimate.rationale: Goodrick-Clarke (ch. 10) describes the scene's 'fascist myths of patriotic revolution' and the Swedish skinzine calling for a 'white revolution without mercy'; The Turner Diaries is a narrative of 'the Great Revolution'.

state-arms-monopoly.rationale: The Turner Diaries (ch. I) condemns the law outlawing all private ownership of firearms and praises those who hid their weapons.

suppress-opposition.rationale: In The Turner Diaries (ch. XXIII) the victorious Organization hangs academics, journalists and other 'race traitors' on the Day of the Rope.
